stack.name: mb3r-stack
notes: Generic integration and distribution layer only. No upstream Bering or Sheaft source code is vendored here.
Draft v1 bundle prepared for Bering v1.0.0 and Sheaft v1.0.0 artifacts; immutable GHCR digests remain TODO until upstream releases are published.
OpenTelemetry Demo is packaged as an example profile, not as the core contract.

Bering v1.0.0 is expected to publish the 1.1.0 stochastic connectivity contract line with reliability evidence, operation-aware edge identity, endpoint semantic hints, and Sheaft compatibility fixtures.
Sheaft v1.0.0 is expected to consume the Bering v1 contract line and validate product-baseline P_Node * P_Edge stochastic connectivity with edge-aware immediate and eventual predicates.
This draft is not a verified runtime bundle until upstream v1 release manifests, image digests, stack release dry-run, and live smoke evidence are attached.
